bio.text: Steve Montenegro is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives representing District 29; he assumed office on January 9, 2023, and House Republicans selected him as speaker of the House on November 12, 2024.
He was first elected to the Arizona House in 2008 and later served in the Arizona Senate.
He was born in El Salvador and immigrated to the United States, and has a bachelor's degree in political science from Arizona State University and an associate degree in theology.
He has served as pastor at Catalyst Church, worked as executive director of the nonprofit Desert Reach, and been a principal at the government affairs firm Coronam Consulting.
